entries.title: Psalms 118:1
segments: ¶Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for [He is] good! For His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:2
segments: Let Israel now say, "His mercy [endures] forever."

entries.title: Psalms 118:3
segments: Let the house of Aaron now say, "His mercy [endures] forever."

entries.title: Psalms 118:4
segments: Let those who fear the LORD now say, "His mercy [endures] forever."

entries.title: Psalms 118:5
segments: I called on the LORD in distress; The LORD answered me [and set me] in a broad place.

entries.title: Psalms 118:6
segments: The LORD [is] on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?

entries.title: Psalms 118:7
segments: The LORD is for me among those who help me; Therefore I shall see [my desire] on those who hate me.

entries.title: Psalms 118:8
segments: [It is] better to trust in the LORD Than to put confidence in man.

entries.title: Psalms 118:9
segments: [It is] better to trust in the LORD Than to put confidence in princes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:10
segments: All nations surrounded me, But in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:11
segments: They surrounded me, Yes, they surrounded me; But in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:12
segments: They surrounded me like bees; They were quenched like a fire of thorns; For in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:13
segments: You pushed me violently, that I might fall, But the LORD helped me.

entries.title: Psalms 118:14
segments: The LORD [is] my strength and song, And He has become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:15
segments: The voice of rejoicing and salvation [Is] in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

entries.title: Psalms 118:16
segments: The right hand of the LORD is exalted; The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

entries.title: Psalms 118:17
segments: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 118:18
segments: The LORD has chastened me severely, But He has not given me over to death.

entries.title: Psalms 118:19
segments: ¶Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will go through them, [And] I will praise the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 118:20
segments: This is the gate of the LORD, Through which the righteous shall enter.

entries.title: Psalms 118:21
segments: I will praise You, For You have answered me, And have become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:22
segments: The stone [which] the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone.

entries.title: Psalms 118:23
segments: This was the LORD'S doing; It [is] marvelous in our eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:24
segments: This [is] the day the LORD has made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.

entries.title: Psalms 118:25
segments: Save now, I pray, O LORD; O LORD, I pray, send now prosperity.

entries.title: Psalms 118:26
segments: Blessed [is] he who comes in the name of the LORD! We have blessed you from the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 118:27
segments: God [is] the LORD, And He has given us light; Bind the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.

entries.title: Psalms 118:28
segments: You [are] my God, and I will praise You; [You are] my God, I will exalt You.

entries.title: Psalms 118:29
segments: Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for [He is] good! For His mercy [endures] forever.
